//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Nether Portal Spread -> Config

Enable Nether Portal Spread.//: Whether Nether Portal Spread is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

sendMessageOnPortalCreation.//: When enabled, sends a message to players around the portal that the nether is spreading and that you can stop the spread with 'preventSpreadBlockAmountNeeded' of the 'preventSpreadBlockString' block.

messageOnPortalCreation.//: The message sent on portal creation.
messageOnPortalCreation.value: You feel a corrupted energy coming from the portal. The nether will slowly spread into the overworld unless %preventSpreadBlockAmountNeeded% %preventSpreadBlockString% are placed within a %portalSpreadRadius% block radius around the portal.

sendMessageOnPreventSpreadBlocksFound.//: When enabled, sends a message to players around the portal that the nether spread has stopped when the portal detects new 'preventSpreadBlockString' blocks.

messageOnPreventSpreadBlocksFound.//: The message sent on preventspread blocks found.
messageOnPreventSpreadBlocksFound.value: With enough %preventSpreadBlockString% placed, you feel the corrupted energy fade.

sendMessageOnPortalBroken.//: When enabled, sends a message to players around the portal when it is broken.

messageOnPortalBroken.//: The message sent when a portal is broken.
messageOnPortalBroken.value: With the nether portal broken, the corrupted energy is no longer able to enter the overworld.

prefixPortalCoordsInMessage.//: When enabled, shows the portal coordinates in portal messages.

portalSpreadRadius.//: The radius around the portal to which the nether blocks can spread. min: 1, max: 100

spreadDelayTicks.//: The delay in ticks in between the spread around the nether portal. 20 ticks = 1 second. min: 1, max: 72,000

instantConvertAmount.//: The amount of blocks that are instantly converted to a nether block around a portal when it is detected. If there are existing nether blocks within the radius, their count is substracted from this number. min: 0, max: 1,000

preventSpreadWithBlock.//: When enabled, blocks the spread effect when there are n (defined) prevent-spread-blocks (defined) within the radius.

preventSpreadBlockAmountNeeded.//: The amount of prevent-spread-blocks (defined) needed within the radius of the nether portal to prevent spread. min: 1, max: 100

preventSpreadBlockString.//: The block which prevents the nether portal from spreading. By default a coal block (minecraft:coal_block is the namespace ID).
